tests.setup: Committed blob with read_bytes patched to fail.
tests.oracle: Existing digest is returned without calling read_bytes.

tests.title: GC grace starts at commit and renews on deduplication
tests.setup: Fresh and old blobs, old staging, and an old deduplicated blob.
tests.action: Commit or deduplicate, then run orphan cleanup with grace.
tests.oracle: Fresh commits and renewed blobs survive; old orphan is removed; default zero grace removes remaining orphan; negative grace rejects.

tests.title: Verified export publishes valid content only
tests.setup: Multichunk blob then tampered committed content.
tests.action: Export valid, tampered, and missing blobs.
tests.oracle: Valid export matches bytes/count; tampering leaves no destination or temporary export; missing blob raises ArtifactNotFoundError.

tests.title: Commit requests shard and new-root-entry sync
tests.setup: Spy on _fsync_dir for new and existing shard commits.
tests.action: Commit two blobs in the same shard.
tests.oracle: New shard requests shard then root sync; existing shard requests shard sync only. Test proves calls, not physical crash durability.

tests.title: Work CAS repairs stale views and rejects losing changes
tests.setup: Independent Work projections over one authoritative stream.
tests.action: Use stale revisions and race legal transitions.
tests.oracle: Stale cache repairs; losing caller gets WorkRevisionConflictError; replay agrees with exactly one winner.

tests.title: Work recovers durable Records with missing or stale projections
tests.setup: Projection save fails after creation or transition append.
tests.action: Restore saving, mutate, or retry identical/conflicting creation.
tests.oracle: Record-derived state permits continuation; identical missing-row revision-1 creation repairs without another Record; conflicting content rejects.

tests.title: Failed Work rebuild preserves existing projection
tests.setup: Existing work item and exploding record source or replacement writer.
tests.oracle: Existing item remains after record-source failure and replacement transaction rollback.

tests.title: Skill and capability CAS uses authoritative Records
tests.setup: Independent skill/catalog views over one stream.
tests.action: Mutate stale views and race skill transitions/capability updates.
tests.oracle: Caches repair; losing changes reject; concurrent capability updates have one winner.

tests.title: Skill/catalog creation and mutation save failures recover
tests.setup: Durable registration/declaration or transition with projection save failing.
tests.action: Restore saving, transition/update, and retry registration or conflicting declaration.
tests.oracle: Missing rows recover from Records; skill registration is not duplicated; conflicting capability declaration rejects; stale transition projection resumes.

tests.title: Record-only skill/catalog rebuild preserves authority and failed-source state
tests.setup: Recorded skill/capability state, changed skill files, and an exploding record source.
tests.action: Rebuild without skill_roots and verify integrity.
tests.oracle: Recorded digest survives; drift raises SkillTamperedError; failed record source preserves existing capability.

tests.title: Tree digest frames boundaries and rejects changed streamed size
tests.setup: Trees colliding under old NUL framing and a file grown during hashing.
tests.oracle: Distinct trees differ; stable hashing is deterministic; streamed-size change raises SecurityBoundaryError.

tests.title: Fallback parses tested inline lists consistently
tests.setup: Frontmatter with plain/quoted inline list entries and empty list.
tests.action: Parse normally and with yaml import unavailable.
tests.oracle: Both parses equal the explicit expected dictionary.

tests.title: Restore boundary includes extension databases
tests.setup: Managed target with core and derived databases; optional active extension writer.
tests.action: Restore over idle and busy targets.
tests.oracle: Idle restore discards derived databases from target and retains them in previous directory; busy extension writer rejects before directory swap; foreign files reject.

tests.title: Directory recovery restores absent target and preserves completed restore
tests.setup: Crash between renames or stale intent marker after completed swap.
tests.oracle: Absent target recovers every previous database; present restored target is retained and stale marker removed.
tests.failure_injection: os._exit between renames and stale marker

tests.title: Derived rebuild accepts supplied projection and reads all pages
tests.setup: 105 authoritative creation Records and caller-constructed WorkProjection.
tests.oracle: All 105 items rebuild; read cursors cover every page; supplied projection port is used.

tests.title: Evaluation rejects forged source digest or count
tests.setup: Trace with changed content and copied digest; dataset with forged digest/count.
tests.oracle: EvalSourceMismatchError before a report is returned.

tests.title: Report binds trace digest and optionally verifies dataset artifact
tests.setup: Registered dataset, trace, and a store; separately an unregistered dataset.
tests.action: Run evaluation and verify supplied report sources.
tests.oracle: target_digest equals trace digest; valid sources verify; same trace ID with different content rejects; missing dataset artifact rejects when store is supplied.

tests.title: Evaluator mutations reject without changing caller sources
tests.setup: Evaluators mutate nested trace attributes or dataset expectations.
tests.oracle: Post-execution verification raises EvalSourceMismatchError; caller's nested source content remains unchanged.
